summary: Pole platform and cabin dated 1926, a 20-foot live-in tower listed for 1936, and destruction in the 1940s; no account of the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in the 1940s according to the sources; no source describes what remains on the site.

events.note: Pole platform tower with a frame cabin.
20-foot live-in tower. Sources do not say whether it replaced the 1926 platform.
Seth Manning named as on the lookout, July 10, 1947 item (Sandpoint News-Bulletin, via Forest Lookouts).
Virgil Jore and his wife named as stationed there that summer, July 14, 1949 item (Sandpoint News-Bulletin, via Forest Lookouts).

evidence.supports: 1926 pole platform tower with frame cabin
six miles northeast of Spirit Lake
Sandpoint News-Bulletin as the source of the 1947 item

evidence.quote: Seth Manning is on the Clagstone lookout.

evidence.supports: Virgil Jore and wife stationed there, 1949
evidence.quote: Mr. and Mrs. Virgil Jore are stationed at the Clagstone lookout this summer.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts give only the 1940s for destruction, but a July 14, 1949 item still places Virgil Jore and his wife at the lookout. If both are right, the loss came after July 1949.

notes_for_editor: Location conflict not resolved: idaho_fl gives 48.02738, -116.7817 and firelookout.com and the FFLA list give 48.02515, -116.76994, roughly 0.9 km apart. No source checked says which is the site. The 1940s destruction has no exact year; a 1940 'destroyed' placeholder event was removed because a dated 1940 loss would contradict the July 1949 staffing. The 1936 tower may or may not replace the 1926 platform. The 20-foot figure is taken as height_m; it is the tower height as stated. Pend Oreille TPA is a label on firelookout.com and is not expanded here. Nothing about fires or access was found.
